script: Why did the nanny cam catch my mother-in-law switching my baby's medication the week she moved in? But she volunteered to help before I even asked. Because she needed access to the nursery unsupervised. I only checked the footage because the new formula wasn't working the way the pediatrician promised. At two in the morning, the camera showed her opening a drawer that wasn't hers to open. She replaced the drops in the dropper bottle with something from her own purse. I had it tested before I said a single word to anyone. It wasn't medication at all, it was an over the counter sedative, diluted enough to just make him sleep through the night. She told my husband she was doing it so I could finally rest. I asked her how long she had been doing it before I checked the footage. She said she lost count. And the question my husband still hasn't asked her is the one I keep coming back to.
